correctness.rationale: Kac-Abramov renewal induction plus relative entropy proves the exact pressure/unique equilibrium for all t>=0. Effective PNT and Laplace tail expansions rigorously give Euler gamma pressure constant and fixed-x first gap correction; derivative controls density, Legendre variationality controls constrained entropy, and the stationary size-biased renewal limit yields Poisson locations. A standalone finite checker corroborates only finite instances, not the asymptotic theorem.

value.rationale: Prime gaps are a natural arithmetically sparse allowed-run set (count~y/log y). Their PNT density produces a sharp loglog entropy penalty compared with unrestricted binary shifts and a nontrivial Euler-constant correction, while rare marker locations have a universal Poisson limit with an explicit first arithmetic correction. These are motivated intrinsic thermodynamic and statistical invariants, not arbitrary parameter slices.
